title: AI Compiler and Kernel Intern
description: NVIDIA is looking for an AI Compiler & Kernel Intern to apply AI agents, machine learning, and performance engineering to compilers, GPU kernels, and developer tools. You will work with compiler, kernel, and AI engineers on a scoped project involving code, compiler and kernel feedback, performance experiments, and optimization. Depending on your background and interests, the work may focus on agentic workflows, learned models, compiler optimization, GPU kernel development, performance analysis, or AI-enabled developer tools. Candidates may enter from either a compiler or kernel background; experience in every area is not expected. What You’ll Be Doing: Build AI-agent workflows that interact with code, compilers, GPU kernels, benchmarks, performance tools, and engineering systems. Develop tools that help agents collect data, run experiments, analyze compiler, kernel, and performance feedback, identify optimization opportunities, and recommend next steps. Explore data-driven approaches for compiler optimization, GPU kernel generation and tuning, performance prediction, decision support, and workflow automation. Build reliable interfaces between AI agents and compiler, kernel, or developer-tool infrastructure. Prototype improvements to compiler flows, code generation, GPU kernels, optimization tools, experimentation systems, or developer workflows. Work with compiler, kernel, architecture, AI, and performance engineers to evaluate ideas on representative workloads. Measure correctness, runtime performance, compile time, resource utilization, reliability, and other relevant outcomes. Document the design, experiments, results, limitations, and next steps. What We Need to See: Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field . Strong programming skills in Python, C, C++, or a similar language. Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, software engineering, and quantitative problem solving. Coursework, research, or project experience in one or more of these areas: AI, machine learning, AI agents, compilers, programming languages, GPU kernels, CUDA or accelerator programming, systems, performance engineering, optimization, or developer tools. Ability to design experiments, analyze results, investigate technical problems, and communicate findings clearly. Experience working in one or more of AI, compiler, kernel, performance, or systems areas, with the ability to learn across technical boundaries. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Experience building AI agents, LLM applications, evaluation systems, coding workflows, or developer tools. Experience with LLVM, MLIR, compiler optimization passes, code generation, domain-specific languages, or compiler infrastructure. Experience writing, analyzing, or optimizing GPU kernels using CUDA, Triton, or a similar accelerator programming model. Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, evolutionary algorithms, predictive modeling, ranking, search, or high-dimensional data analysis. Research, internships, open-source contributions, or personal projects that measure runtime, compile time, resource use, code quality, or developer productivity Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The expected hourly rate for this position is 20 USD – 94 USD. You will also be eligible for Intern benefits . ​ Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 6, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Hardware Signal Integrity Intern, MS - Summer 2027
description:
About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact The Cloud Platform Optics team builds highly integrated component platforms with high-speed Silicon photonics, transmit and receive amplifiers, controller ASIC’s with Marvell DSP’s. These components are made operational with a highly functional embedded firmware. The team is responsible for design, verification, and validation of these integrated high speed optical components. The team performs system level testing under various operating conditions, and validates the performance of the hardware, firmware and control loops. An engineer in this team will be involved in a full product lifecycle and will carry new products from inception all the way to NPI. What You Can Expect We are seeking a motivated and talented Electrical Hardware Engineering Intern to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of electrical hardware design and development, with a keen interest in developing platform solutions for the AI market. This role offers an excellent learning opportunity in a fast-paced environment. Assist in the design, development, and testing of electrical hardware for optical modules and other AI platforms. Perform hands-on testing and debugging of hardware components using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies and signal analyzer. Participate in hardware validation and verification, including debugging and troubleshooting. Help develop and maintain detailed design documentation, including schematics, PCB layouts, and BOMs. What We're Looking For Currently enrolled in a Bachelors or Master’s Degree in CS/EE, or a related field with an expected graduation date of Fall 2027 – Summer 2028 Completed courses in electric, circuit design and programming. Strong understanding of electrical engineering principles and practices. Familiarity with CAD tools for schematic capture and PCB layout (e.g., Allegro, OrCAD). Proficiency in using lab equipment, with a good understanding of electrical measurement and testing methodologies. Expected Base Pay Range (USD) 33 - 66, $ per hour. The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com . title: FY27 Intern - Deep Learning Researcher Internship - 4 months, Amsterdam
description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies Netherlands B.V. Job Area: Interns Group, Interns Group > Interim Intern General Summary: At Qualcomm AI Research, we are advancing AI to make its core capabilities – perception, reasoning, and action – ubiquitous across devices. Our mission is to make breakthroughs in fundamental AI research and scale them across industries. By bringing together some of the best minds in the field, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and shaping the future of AI. We have multiple positions available for our 4-month Deep Learning Research internship program. As a Deep Learning Research Intern, you will develop, prototype, and implement new fundamental and impactful methods in one of our research areas. The internship program gives you a unique opportunity to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence and publish at scientific conferences. You will join a team of talented and experienced researchers and engineers and become part of our collaborative and interdisciplinary environment. Our research areas include: Model Efficiency : Advancing efficiency of generative models and architectures with innovations in, e.g., model quantization, compression, sparsity, conditional computation (e.g., mixture of experts), application to LLMs/LVMs/multi-modal models. Generative Vision : Research on efficient generative modeling of visual and multimodal data using diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive methods, Gaussian Splatting, VLMs, and MLLMs. Agentic AI & Reasoning : Research on agentic AI system and algorithms, long horizon planning, inference time compute, RL training of reasoning LLMs, generative reward models and LLM sampling techniques. Embodied AI : Research on manipulation (Vision-Language-Action models, diffusion), loco-manipulation on humanoid robots, learning-from-human-videos, and reinforcement learning applied to these topics. Robustness & Alignment : Research on robust & efficient methods to align models for safe, reliable, and resource-constrained edge, emphasizing controllable generation, uncertainty quantification, guardrails and on-device adaptation techniques. Requirements We welcome applications from motivated PhD candidates. Applicants must be enrolled in their PhD degree program for the duration of the internship. Ideal applicants are currently pursuing a PhD with focus on machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer vision, or foundation models (LLMs/LVMs) and have proven research ability, e.g., having published at relevant academic conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.). Why join us At Qualcomm AI Research, you will be part of a team with a wide range of backgrounds that values innovation and creativity. You will be part of a global company (headquartered in San Diego) and work closely with exceptional researchers and engineers that publish at major conferences. You will work on-site at our office located at the campus of the University of Amsterdam and live in a scenic, vibrant city with high living standards, numerous cultural activities, and plenty of green spaces. Qualcomm offers interns flexible start dates between November 2026 and July 2027, a competitive salary, relocation assistance, and holiday & sick pay. *References to a particular number of years experience are for indicative purposes only. Applications from candidates with equivalent experience will be considered, provided that the candidate can demonstrate an ability to fulfill the principal duties of the role and possesses the required competencies. title: AI Foundations - Technical Product Management - Internship 2027
description: Join IBM's AI product organization and help bring cutting-edge artificial intelligence offerings to market. As a Technical Product Management Intern, Artificial Intelligence Foundation, you will work alongside experienced product managers, engineers, designers, and customers to shape how AI technologies become real-world offerings. You will gain end-to-end exposure to the technical product management lifecycle within a portfolio that spans machine learning, generative AI, and enterprise AI solutions, all in a collaborative environment that bridges business strategy and transformative technology. As a Technical Product Management Intern, Artificial Intelligence Foundation, you will support detailed direction on key technical and marketing tasks to launch an offering feature, offering, or collection of offerings. You will contribute to key outcome metrics, while developing hands-on product management expertise at enterprise scale. Your primary responsibilities will include: Drive Offering Development: Collaborate with development leaders, product architects, product designers, and key customers to package features into offering releases, ensuring offering designs reflect business objectives. Deliver Customer Validation: Drive customer validation through beta programs and client meetings, confirming requirements are addressed by the delivered solution and analyzing feedback to identify potential gaps or opportunities. Manage Offering Delivery: Drive cross-functional collaborative efforts to meet offering schedule commitments, and actively manage the plan of delivery including associated risks. Showcase Offering Capabilities: Demonstrate offering capabilities and value proposition to external stakeholders, including customers, partners, leaders and analysts. Develop Digital Assets: Work with development and marketing to deliver digital assets in support of always-on marketing and digital engagement, such as interactive demos and trials/evaluations. Business Foundations: Enrollment in an MBA program with a concentration in product management, strategy, marketing, or a related field. AI Familiarity: Working knowledge of the AI solution landscape, including machine learning and generative AI concepts, sufficient to discuss them credibly with technical teams and customers. Analytical Skills: Experience conducting market, competitive, or financial analysis and translating findings into actionable recommendations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with engineering, design, and marketing teams. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to stakeholders. AI/ML Exposure: Coursework, projects, or prior internship experience involving AI/ML products or data-driven decision making Product Management Exposure: Familiarity with agile development practices, product lifecycle management, or prior product-focused work experience Industry Knowledge: Exposure to enterprise software, cloud, or AI industries is a plus.
